data.define: Used to agree to a plan.

misuse.text: Don't say 'works for me' if the time's bad.
misuse.why: People will plan around your yes.

publish.title: What does "works for me" mean?
publish.value: Works for me = That's fine with me. Example: "Seven o'clock works for me." (casual English).
